anchor._why: the squad's states wobble on the ground line (koa's north kneel dug 2 rows below standing, sable's lateral kneels floated 2 above) - so the RE-FRAME anchors each STRIP by its own measured ground row: dy = FEET_Y minus the strip's last-opaque row, one constant per strip, never per frame. Cipher's re-frame keeps its single recorded constant - his states never wobbled; this rule is the squad record's own.

mark_guard._why: per frame, the count of pixels within euclidean tol of the fighter's mark RGB must sit within slack of the same count on that facing's identity rotation. Measured across all accepted frames before recording: worst deviation 14 (the breathing template softens koa's mint band). The guard's honest scope at slack 16: it catches gross identity loss (a strong mark vanishing, dev >= 17) and large inventions - NOT subtle defects; the designer's lineup eyeball is the real identity gate and it already ran.
